subject: Align demo schedule & capacity kickoff — FinPay throughput checklist
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@finpay.com>
Cc: Lydia Gomez <lydia.gomez@finpay.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 1 Aug 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (demo slot & capacity kickoff)

Hi Samir —

Great to meet today — really appreciate you walking us through FinPay’s payment routing flow and the spike you saw when settlement batches run. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we can keep momentum: 

- Goal from FinPay: shore up production inference for fraud-score enrichment during settlement windows with predictable latency (p95 < 120ms) and throughput up to ~400 req/s during peak batches.
- Immediate ask from your side: a hands-on capacity kickoff to validate GPU pool sizing and latency SLO tradeoffs, followed by a technical demo for your engineering team.

Can we lock the capacity kickoff (30–45m) next week? I’ve attached a short throughput template — if you can populate a few rows (arrival rates, payload size, typical sequence lengths) it will help our prep.

Proposed windows (PST):
- Tue Aug 3 — 10:00–10:45 or 15:00–15:45
- Wed Aug 4 — 09:00–09:45 or 16:00–16:45

If none of these work, send 2–3 alternatives and I’ll match with Marissa/Jordan. After the capacity kickoff we’ll follow with a 45m demo + ops deep-dive that includes your infra folks.

Attachments: finpay_throughput_template_v1.xlsx (fillable), redwood_demo-agenda.pdf

Thanks — looking forward,

Alex Martinez
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192


---
Note: Please also include your SRE/Infra lead on the kickoff so we can cover network egress and data residency requirements up front.
From: Samir Khan <samir.khan@finpay.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lydia Gomez <lydia.gomez@finpay.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (demo slot & capacity kickoff)

Alex — thanks for the clear recap. Attachments received and I’ll get the template to Lydia to fill the numbers.

We can do Tue Aug 3 at 15:00 PST (15:00–15:45). I’ll invite our SRE lead (Priya Shah) and our ML engineer (Diego).

One thing to flag: during settlement windows we see bursts that push CPU-bound services to the limit; we want to understand expected GPU footprint per request and whether Redwood supports pre-warming KV caches to keep cold-start latency low. If you can include that in the agenda that’d be ideal.

—Samir
Head of Integrations, FinPay
samir.khan@finpay.com
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Khan <samir.khan@finpay.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Lydia Gomez <lydia.gomez@finpay.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (demo slot & capacity kickoff)

Perfect — Tue 15:00 PST locked. I’ve tentatively blocked 15:00–16:00 on our side to allow a bit of buffer. Marissa and Jordan are copied to ensure we have the right capacity/solutions folks on the call.

Agenda (30m core + 15m buffer):
1) 5m — introductions & success criteria (p95 latency target, throughput targets)
2) 10m — FinPay throughput profile (you + Priya/Diego walk through the template)
3) 10m — Redwood capacity recommendations (pool sizing, pre-warm / KV cache strategy, batching tradeoffs)
4) 5m — next steps & owner assignments (demo scheduling, access/credentials, POC timeline)

Jordan — can you prepare a rough GPU pool recommendation (N GPUs for baseline + burst) and a short note on pre-warm strategies we typically use for settlement-like bursts?

Marissa — will follow up on commercial cadence and any procurement items to flag before a POC.

Samir / Lydia — attaching the calendar invite link here: https://cal.redwood.ai/alex/30min and the template is at https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/f/finpay-throughput-template 

See you Tue — I’ll send a calendar invite from my email once I have Marissa/Jordan’s confirmation.

Alex
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir.khan@finpay.com>, Lydia Gomez <lydia.gomez@finpay.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Aug 2027 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (demo slot & capacity kickoff)

Thanks all — I’ve uploaded a short runbook extract and a preliminary sizing note to the shared Drive (link below) and accepted the calendar invite. High-level preview: for p95 < 120ms at ~400 req/s we’re likely looking at a baseline pool of 4 A100-class instances with burst capacity to 6–8 depending on batching window and model quantization. Pre-warm options: KV cache pinning and persistent worker pools — I’ll bring numbers to the call.

Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/f/finpay-throughput-template

Marissa — please include procurement checklist items in the invite so Samir has visibility into next steps on commercial side.

Jordan Blake
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
